content:
Every month, millions of Indian employers face the same awkward dilemma. 

Your cook or driver needs urgent cash, you want to help, but asking for it back later is a nightmare.

Enter Fund My Staff, launched by Ashneer and Madhuri. 

The model is so simple.
Instead of paying out of your own pocket, you give a digital guarantee on the app. His NBFC, Ash Grove Capital, disburses the actual loan.

Your staff gets funds for medical emergencies or school fees, you preserve your goodwill, and no one has to play debt collector.

In the background, it quietly pulls unorganized blue-collar workers into the formal economy, building them a solid 800 credit score.

This isn't just an app - it's the next huge play by his parent company, Third Unicorn. 

Grover didn't pick that name by accident after building Grofers (that is now Blinkit) and BharatPe.

It's a direct public statement to build his third billion-dollar startup.

After disbursing ₹80 Cr+ in medical loans via ZeroPe, Third Unicorn is now capturing the unorganized micro-loans hiding inside millions of Indian homes.

Slowly, informal domestic goodwill is turning into structured fintech infrastructure.

Would you guarantee a loan for your staff over giving a cash advance?
comment: The interesting challenge will be underwriting trust. Domestic workers often lack formal data, so repayment behavior, dispute handling, and responsible lending practices will decide whether this scales sustainably.
